correctness.rationale: For every efficient open dominating set the two sides are independent exact covers. All point covers are proved affine ternary Latin squares (12), and all line covers are proved axis-layer tilings (21). The minimum replacement counts of 6 and 3 are proved, yielding the complete four-partite point factor and the three-cube glued tiling factor. Cartesian-product distances give 252 vertices, 1566 edges, all pair-distance counts, and universal eccentricity 6. The 1296 coordinate transformations give two orbits. Direct independent exact-cover, per-code neighborhood, all-source BFS, and affine/layer-construction scripts executed successfully from the actual files. No computational sample is extrapolated beyond the fixed graph.

value.rationale: The Gray graph is the smallest semisymmetric cubic graph and has a canonical 27-point/27-line incidence model. Complete classification of its exact open-neighborhood codes is a natural and motivated finite invariant. More substantially, the theorem identifies the minimum local code operations with Latin-square bitrades and planar line trades, derives a connected product geometry and sharp universal six-trade bound, and separates two automorphism orbits. These are structural reconfiguration results, not merely the previously tabulated tiling count or a routine numerical gain.
